sentence: Antibiotics used for urinary tract infections; nitrofurantoin is described by the NHS as a medicine for lower urinary tract infections such as cystitis.
Antibiotics in this group work by killing the bacteria that cause infection, and they have no effect on infections caused by viruses.
note: MedlinePlus: antibiotic, kills bacteria; not for viral infections.

sentence: Kidney function is checked before nitrofurantoin is prescribed, particularly in older people.
Stopping early or skipping doses can make an infection harder to treat and may promote resistance.
Nausea, diarrhoea, loss of appetite and headaches are the usual side effects of nitrofurantoin.
